section_summary.extract_value: This section presents confirmatory factor analysis results for a 10-item one-factor model examining body appreciation across the whole sample and subsamples stratified by gender and weight status. The model demonstrated acceptable fit overall, but invariance testing revealed statistically significant differences across gender (p = .01), which were resolved after freeing thresholds for specific items (M1P, p = .07). No significant differences were found across weight status categories (p = .33).

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a Confirmatory Factor Analysis of a 10-item one-factor BAS-2 model tested on a whole sample (N=840) and across gender subgroups (Boys n=438, Girls n=402) and weight status subgroups (UW & NW n=592, OW & OB n=248). Table 1 displays standardized factor loadings and standard errors for each BAS-2 item across these subgroups, with all loadings statistically significant (p < .001). The analysis tested measurement invariance across gender and weight status, finding significant differences in gender invariance that were resolved after freeing specific item thresholds.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) of a 10-item one-factor model for body appreciation in adolescents. The analysis examined measurement invariance across gender (Boys n=438, Girls n=402) and weight status groups (Underweight & Normoweight n=592, Overweight & Obese n=248). The model showed acceptable fit overall, with statistically significant differences in invariance testing across gender that were resolved through partial metric invariance (M1P), while no significant differences were found across weight status groups.
